# QuickTap

> QuickTap is a premium NFC card and tag brand based in Egypt. Our products let users share their digital profiles, contact information, and social links with a single tap on any NFC-enabled smartphone. No app required.

## Products
- QuickTap Smart Card: Premium NFC business card with custom design. Price starts from: EGP 50.
- QuickTap Smart Tag: Adhesive NFC tag for existing cards. Price starts from: EGP 50.

## Features
- One-tap sharing via NFC
- No app required
- Fully customizable design
- Instant link updates
- Compatible with any modern NFC phone
- Analytics dashboard
